labeling: Hand-written from the code facts of each synthetic sample (2026-09-24). Inline 'c3-expect' markers fix the line; this file gives the rationale. Never regenerate from scanner output.

004-phase2-taint.claim_basis: Message 'User-controlled input reaches <sink>'; sink pattern covers eval/exec (CWE-95), system/popen/Command (CWE-78) and query/execute/executeQuery (CWE-89).

004-taint-source-to-sink.definition: src/ai_code_audit/taint.py TaintAnalyzer, routed from src/ai_code_audit/scanner.py for python/go/java
004-taint-source-to-sink.claim_basis: Message '<variable> is read from <source> and reaches <sink>'; the analyser tracks a named variable from source to sink, covering the same sink families as the heuristic (added 2026-09-26 when the builtin scanner switched python to dataflow).

CG-OG-PY-001.claim_basis: Rule metadata cwe CWE-95; sources input(...), os.getenv(...), sys.argv; sinks eval(...), exec(...) (sys.argv and exec added in C3, 2026-09-24).

PY-CI-01.rationale: input() value passed unchanged to eval.

PY-CI-02.rationale: Environment variable is caller-controlled and passed to eval.

PY-CI-04.rationale: input() value passed to exec; same class as eval (CWE-95).

PY-CI-05.rationale: eval parameter only ever receives input() from main(); sink line precedes the source line.

PY-CMD-01.rationale: input() concatenated into an os.system shell command.

PY-CMD-02.rationale: sys.argv interpolated into an os.popen shell command.

PY-FP-01.rationale: eval receives a string constant; input() result is discarded.

PY-FP-02.rationale: ast.literal_eval only evaluates literals; not code execution.

PY-FP-03.rationale: eval( appears only inside a comment.

PY-FP-04.rationale: system( appears only inside a string literal passed to print.

PY-FP-05.rationale: subprocess.call with a constant argument list and no shell.

PY-FP-06.rationale: exec receives a string constant; sys.argv is only counted.

PY-FIX-02.rationale: eval replaced by an allow-list lookup; unknown keys raise KeyError.

PY-FIX-03.rationale: Shell string replaced by an argument list without shell=True.
